findings.summary: sc-agent-compose hard-codes consumer identities (CliPathPolicy, PythonPathPolicy); every new consumer edits a published pinned crate; ComposeInputs never defined.
findings.remediation: One PathPolicy data type (or trait) with cli()/python() presets living in the roots; define ComposeInputs fields in r-3b and ADR-SAG-0026.

findings.summary: Response contract still in two places: RunResponse derives Serialize AND has to_envelope_data(); {version, operation, data} wrapper stays in sc-ai; ScAgentErrorResponse gains no version/retryable on the wire.
findings.remediation: One serialization; move wrapper next to RunResponse (sc-jev-check or compose); add optional schema_version/retryable/details to ScAgentErrorResponse in r-1 while the types break is open.

findings.summary: BackendStatus::Failed{code: String, message: String} is stringly; drops fix_hint/retryable; each consumer re-implements partial-failure policy as prose.
findings.remediation: Failed carries ScAgentErrorResponse; RunResponse::first_failure() and is_partial() so CLI/Python/MCP share the exit/exception decision.

findings.summary: Adding a backend is still a coordinated edit to sc-agent-types (variant + BACKENDS row) and sc-jev-check (factory); factory owner unspecified; 'no match outside ids.rs' grep test is brittle.
findings.remediation: State in ADR-SAG-0009/0027 that adding a backend is a minor types change; BackendRegistry::register(descriptor_id, factory) with built-ins registered by sc-jev-check; compile-time check instead of grep.

findings.summary: ask consumers cannot get a production registry without copying sc-ai: registry_for_repo goes pub(crate), compose covers only prepare/run.
findings.remediation: Public BackendRegistry::from_env(repo_root, key_resolver) or RunConfig::build_registry(); compose::ask_from beside run_from; document registry injection as the no-secrets path (closes EXT-009).

findings.summary: prepare(source,&config) and run(prepared,&config) take config twice; mismatch silently accepted.
findings.remediation: PreparedRun captures a config fingerprint and run rejects mismatch, or prepared owns the config.

findings.summary: ResolvedApiKey sealing via Token type + doc(hidden) __transport module + clippy allowlist is ceremony with one implementor and unenforceable downstream.
sc-agent-types keeps growing; split deferred; publishing schema/builder paths now makes a later split breaking.
findings.remediation: Keep schema modules self-contained; note in ADR-SAG-0027 that module paths are the stable surface for a later re-export split.

ext_status.EXT-003: partial (py run_check single signature not stated; with_clock public)

positives: deleting old shims before first publish
deleting dead SessionStore and Extractor traits
